# Input Elements: type Attribute

#### Course: Learn HTML

## Input Elements: type Attribute

#### 1. type="password"

This defines a password field. The characters in a password field are masked (shown as asterisks or circles).

```html
1<form action="/html-form-submit" method="post">
2    <input type="password">
3</form>
```

Browser Output (after adding values)

![A webpage showing an HTML type attribute.](data:image/png;base64,)

If you type in the input box, the letters will be masked as asterisks. Go ahead and try it out.

#### 2. type="submit"

This creates a button for submitting the form.

```html
1<form action="/html-form-submit" method="post">
2    <input type="submit">
3</form>
```

Browser Output

![A webpage showing an HTML type attribute.](data:image/png;base64,)
